bluemarble.hint: Drag to turn it, scroll to come closer. Let go and it keeps turning on its own.
bluemarble.line.sunCity: The sun is directly above {city} right now.
bluemarble.line.sunSea: The sun is directly above open water right now, at {lat}°, {lon}°.
bluemarble.line.night: {n} of {total} cities are in darkness right now.
bluemarble.line.quakeCount: The Earth shook {n} times in the last day.
bluemarble.line.issCity: Several people are passing over {city} right now at {kmh} km/h.
bluemarble.line.issSea: The ISS is {alt} km above open water right now, moving at {kmh} km/h.
bluemarble.line.kpCalm: The Earth's magnetic field is quiet right now.
bluemarble.line.kpStorm: A magnetic storm is coming (Kp {kp}). The aurora reaches further south than usual.
bluemarble.line.aurora: Somewhere near the poles, the sky is shaking green right now.
bluemarble.line.issPass: {when} — at {clock}, people pass {el}° above your head. Look up and you can see them.
bluemarble.line.issPassNone: The ISS does not pass over this place in the next 24 hours.
bluemarble.line.pastDay: This is Earth on {date}. That day’s clouds, where they were.
bluemarble.line.pastQuake: The Earth shook {n} times that day. The largest was magnitude {mag}, near {where}.
bluemarble.line.pastQuiet: Nothing above magnitude 4.5 shook anywhere that day.
bluemarble.line.pastSun: At this hour that day, the sun stood above {lat}°, {lon}°.
